articles.summary: Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, will release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 following the close of the U.S. markets on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Toast will host a conference call to discuss its results at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time the same day. The news release with financial results and a link to the conference call will be accessible at the Toast investor relations website: https://investors.toasttab.com . articles.summary: Toast (NYSE: TOST) responded to the lawsuit filed today by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC): We strongly disagree with the allegations in the lawsuit filed by the FTC and will vigorously defend the Company against the FTC’s claims. In this matter, the FTC is seeking to apply the Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act (ROSCA) — a law Congress passed to address certain online subscription practices — to Toast's commercial agreements with its restaurant customers. No court has held that ROSCA applies to negotiated business-to-business agreements, and we don't believe it applies here. Such an application has the potential to rewrite the laws of commercial contracts and disrupt business-to-business providers across the economy, ultimately resulting in less competitive terms and more harm to small businesses. As previously disclosed in our last quarterly filing, Toast has been cooperating fully with the FTC's review of this matter since mid-2025 and has engaged in good faith throughout,
articles.title: Toast Responds to FTC Lawsuit

articles.summary: Toast (NYSE: TOST) released its 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Employee Survey. Toast annually polls restaurant employees about their jobs, and the takeaway in 2026: While restaurants are feeling the pinch of a shrinking workforce — perhaps for that very reason — there’s been an uptick in restaurant industry employees’ pay and satisfaction. Toast’s survey of 702 restaurant employees — which asked about pay, tips, benefits, AI, and more — shows a significant jump in restaurant employees’ pay satisfaction compared to 2025 and, similarly, a corresponding increase in satisfaction with benefits. 1,2 Read the full 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Employee Survey on the Data by Toast website .
